findings.fix: Optional: add {"content root", "/content", isDemoDocumentsPath, true} to the table.

findings.issue: Possible Duplicated Code: demoESGNotFound and demoLaneHookNotFound (demo_documents.go) are byte-for-byte the same 404 JSON builder, and both resemble existing demoNotFound in demo_client.go. The worker justifies it by lane file ownership (AGENTS.md rule 1), and both are stubs that L3/L4 will replace, so this is tolerable.
findings.fix: Optional: have both hooks call one shared helper. If lane ownership forbids that, leave as is; delete the helper when the lane fills its body.
